systems.system: Electronic survey on citizens' sense of security (algeriepolice.dz/qnss)
systems.owner: Direction générale de la sûreté nationale (national police)
systems.tiers: online, open to the public by link or QR code; launched 2026-08-04

note: The national police's online opinion survey of the public, launched 4 August 2026: a public-facing web form, not a system in which a station records a report or a case, so no fact. Classed public as the nearest class; it takes opinions, not reports.
